defaults.description: Scale defaults every project uses until a per-project override lands.

maxConcurrent.description: Cap on concurrently running workers per project.

idleTtlSeconds.description: Idle TTL before a worker is a reaper candidate, in seconds.

pollIntervalSeconds.description: Delay between supervisor passes, in seconds.

profileKeys.description: Profile keys the supervisor polls per project.

minIdle.description: Project's warm-idle floor (projects settings override the default).

items.description: One project × profile pool with the counts the queue can answer.

description:
Wire shape of `GET /api/v1/compute` — a read-only snapshot of what
the host can honestly observe: the configured provider, the scale
defaults from `Compute:Scale`, and per-profile pool counts derived
from the work-item queue. Capacity (`freeSlots`) and recent spawns
are omitted on purpose — they need a composed compute provider, which
this host does not wire.
